name: Tinker
description: Learn by doing. Teach by showing. An expert shows a hands-on skill once, and the glasses coach a beginner through it.

permissions.description: Takes photos of each step to build a lesson and to check the learner's work.
Hears the expert's explanation, spoken commands and questions.

hardwareRequirements.description: Press instead of speaking a command
Green for a correct step, red for a fix
